messages:
frank: PR #544 (guides/migration/client-timeouts) failed docs CI — preview + spellcheck + vale. Preview link: https://staging-docs/redwood/pr/544
anya: what's the short error blob? paste the CI lines
frank: spellcheck: 'RedWood' incorrect casing -> should be 'Redwood'\nvale: tone/prose: 'We should consider leveraging' flagged -> prefer direct 'Use' or 'Leverage' is banned per style
ci-bot: docs-preview job failed with HTTP 502 from the preview host during rendering. Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/10244/log
spellcheck-bot: Spellcheck: Found 'RedWood' in docs/guides/migration/client-timeouts.md:15 -> replace with 'Redwood'
anya: i've got the 'RedWood' fix locally. will push a commit to normalize casing. For Vale, our style guide forbids 'leverage' — change to 'use' or 'take advantage of' depending on sentence. I'll reword to 'use'.
frank: great. however preview 502 looks intermittent — ci-bot retried twice then gave up. Can infra look into the preview host? if preview keeps flaking we can't get green checks.
docs-qa: seen preview 502 earlier today on a couple PRs. tagging @infra-oncall to check routing/timeout settings for staging-docs cluster.
infra-oncall: looking. we've had a backend pool OOM that can cause 502s on cold builds. I'm bumping pool size and restarting renderer service. ETA ~10m.rank: thanks. pushing two tiny commits now: 1) normalize 'Redwood' casing, 2) replace 'leverage' -> 'use' and simplify the sentence. commit 1782810050
ci-bot: build queued for PR #544 — docs-preview + spellcheck + vale
ci-bot: docs-preview started but failed again with 502 at 1782810112 — automatic retry in 30s
ci-bot: retry 1 -> docs-preview started; spellcheck and vale ran successfully, but preview render failed while building search index (timeout). See logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/10244/log#retry1
infra-oncall: I increased renderer timeouts and restarted the indexer. Re-run should be stable now.
ci-bot: retry 2 -> docs-preview completed successfully. spellcheck and vale passed. linkcheck ran and returned one warning: relative anchor `/api/clients#timeouts` -> 404 (anchor renamed)
anya: anchor rename happened in the API refactor. change link to `/api/clients#connection-and-timeouts` (relative link) and use trailing slash to avoid redirects: `/api/clients/#connection-and-timeouts`
frank: I'll update the link and push one more commit. pushing commit 1782810179
ci-bot: build started for PR #544 — all checks in progress
ci-bot: linkcheck passed. all checks green. Requesting review.
docs-qa: quick render pass looks good. examples render, no broken anchors. One micro-nit: code sample header line exceeds 100 chars, reflowed in preview sample; consider wrapping in example block for readability.
anya: thanks. tiny change made inline, approving.
eng-release: FYI this touches migration docs and will be in tomorrow's docs cut. Since it's docs-only and fixes broken anchor + preview flakiness, fast-track approved; no eng-release blocker.
frank: merging after docs-bot approves. thanks everyone for quick turnaround and infra help.
ci-bot: PR #544 merged by docs-bot at 1782810203
infra-oncall: monitoring preview cluster for next hour; opened infra incident INC-789 for the OOM/root cause analysis
frank: opened follow-up issue #271 to sweep for 'leverage' across docs and replace with 'use' where appropriate
anya: added tests to docs CI checklist to detect 502 flakiness and alert infra earlier. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
